# Cully 0.18.0

- **One setup for every project.** `cully setup` now installs everything in your agent's user configuration (`~/.claude`, `~/.codex`, `~/.cursor`, honoring their config-directory overrides): hooks, the Cully skill, the `/cully` command or prompt, MCP registration and Codex guidance. Run it once from any directory; it never creates a `.cully` folder, edits `AGENTS.md` or adds Cursor commands in the repository you run it from.
- **Detection and uninstall ignore the repository.** Agents are found from installed executables and user configuration. `cully uninstall` removes only Cully's managed user-level files and preserves your own instructions, commands and skills. An existing `AGENTS.override.md` in Codex's directory is respected.
- **Project memory is unchanged.** Sessions still derive project identity from the active repository, and memory stays owner-scoped; installing globally does not combine unrelated projects.
- **`cully eval` scores Cully as one agent.** It checks setup (skills, hooks, a project left untouched, a clean uninstall), the harness audit, the advisor and memory retrieval against planted ground truth, with no model grading a model. Metrics follow ContextBench (recall, precision, F1, redundancy, AUC-Cov), LongMemEval's memory abilities including abstention and knowledge updates, and LivePlan's split between a rule-based monitor and an advisor model. `--live` fails when the advisor cites a figure it was not given. It replaces `cully advisor-eval`. Read what it does and does not prove in the [evaluation guide](https://docs.cully.net/evals).
- **Docs refreshed.** README, installation, agents, quickstart and website describe the user-wide setup and its file locations.

Install the CLI with `cully update --version v0.18.0`, or rerun the [installer](https://docs.cully.net/installation). Refresh managed hooks and skills with `cully setup` using your original options. Memory services need no schema change.
